name: Aldric Stormward

special_abilities.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
special_abilities.desc: +2 to damage rolls when wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons.

special_abilities.name: Second Wind
special_abilities.desc: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain 1d10+5 hit points. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

special_abilities.name: Action Surge
special_abilities.desc: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

special_abilities.name: Extra Attack
special_abilities.desc: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: You have learned to cast spells. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. Spell save DC = 11, Spell attack modifier = +3

special_abilities.name: Weapon Bond
special_abilities.desc: You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You can't be disarmed of that weapon unless you are incapacitated.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longsword (Two-Handed)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Shield (Spell)
reactions.desc: When hit by an attack, increase AC by 5 until the start of your next turn.

reactions.name: Absorb Elements (Spell)
reactions.desc: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, use your reaction to halve the damage and gain resistance until the start of your next turn.

equipment.name: Longsword
equipment.notes: Family heirloom with minor runes, crystal embedded in pommel serves as spellcasting focus

personality.trait: Disciplined and tactical; thinks three moves ahead
personality.ideal: Loyalty - never leave a soldier behind
personality.bond: Jaylen saved my life in the Borderlands Campaign; I owe him everything
personality.flaw: Can be overly protective, sometimes treating others like subordinates

backstory: Served with Jaylen in the Borderlands Campaign three years ago. During a gnoll ambush, Jaylen pulled Aldric from a burning wagon while surrounded by enemies, saving his life. They became inseparable friends, and when Jaylen left military service, Aldric followed to keep his friend safe.
campaign_role: Main player character - party tank and tactical leader

relationships.relationship: Closest friend, saved his life, feels responsible for his safety

name: Kael Windrider

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

special_abilities.name: Trance
special_abilities.desc: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply for 4 hours a day.

special_abilities.name: Mask of the Wild
special_abilities.desc: You can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

special_abilities.name: Fighting Style: Archery
special_abilities.desc: +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

special_abilities.name: Favored Enemy: Humanoids
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track humanoids, as well as on Intelligence checks to recall information about them.

special_abilities.name: Natural Explorer: Grassland
special_abilities.desc: You are particularly familiar with grassland environments and are adept at traveling and surviving in such regions. Benefits include: ignoring difficult terrain, advantage on initiative, first turn advantage against creatures that haven't acted.

special_abilities.name: Primeval Awareness
special_abilities.desc: You can use your action to focus your awareness on the region around you. For 1 minute per level of spell slot expended, you can sense certain creature types within 1 mile (or 6 miles if in favored terrain).

special_abilities.name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
special_abilities.desc: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it's below its hit point maximum.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: You can cast ranger spells. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. Spell save DC = 14, Spell attack modifier = +6

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kael makes two ranged attacks with his longbow.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, plus an additional 1d8 damage if target is below maximum hit points (Colossus Slayer, once per turn).

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Hunter's Mark
bonus_actions.desc: Choose a creature you can see within 90 feet. For 1 hour, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.

equipment.name: Longbow
equipment.notes: Masterwork, carved with leaf patterns and elvish runes meaning 'Truth Seeker'

personality.trait: Observant and patient; often notices details others miss
personality.ideal: Freedom - people should be free to forge their own paths
personality.bond: The four of us are a family forged through shared danger
personality.flaw: Distrusts civilized society and large towns

name: Thora Mossborn

special_abilities.name: Firbolg Magic
special_abilities.desc: You can cast Detect Magic and Disguise Self each once per short or long rest.

special_abilities.name: Hidden Step
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, you can magically turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw.

special_abilities.name: Powerful Build
special_abilities.desc: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

special_abilities.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
special_abilities.desc: You have the ability to communicate in a limited manner with beasts and plants. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return.

special_abilities.name: Wild Shape
special_abilities.desc: You can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest. CR 1 or lower, no flying or swimming speed.

special_abilities.name: Circle Spells: Circle of Spores
special_abilities.desc: You gain access to additional spells: Blindness/Deafness, Gentle Repose, Animate Dead, Gaseous Form.

special_abilities.name: Halo of Spores
special_abilities.desc: You are surrounded by invisible, necrotic spores. When a creature you can see moves into a space within 10 feet of you or starts its turn there, you can use your reaction to deal 1d6 necrotic damage to that creature unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw (DC 14).

special_abilities.name: Symbiotic Entity
special_abilities.desc: As an action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to awaken your spores, gaining 10 temporary hit points. While active, you gain benefits: Halo of Spores deals 2d6 damage, melee weapon attacks deal extra 1d6 poison damage. Lasts 10 minutes.

special_abilities.name: Fungal Infestation
special_abilities.desc: When a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to animate it. It becomes a zombie that acts immediately after your turn. It can only take the Attack action and obeys your mental commands. It dies after 1 hour.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: You can cast druid spells. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. Spell save DC = 14, Spell attack modifier = +7. You can prepare 9 spells.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands. Add 1d6 poison damage if Symbiotic Entity is active.

actions.name: Produce Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Thorn Whip
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d8) piercing damage, and pull the creature up to 10 feet closer.

actions.name: Poison Spray
actions.desc: A creature within 10 feet must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 14) or take 8 (2d12) poison damage.

actions.name: Wild Shape
actions.desc: Transform into a beast form (CR 1 or lower, no flying/swimming speed) for up to 2.5 hours.

actions.name: Symbiotic Entity
actions.desc: Activate spores to gain 10 temporary HP and enhanced damage for 10 minutes.

bonus_actions.name: Hidden Step
bonus_actions.desc: Turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack.

reactions.name: Halo of Spores
reactions.desc: Deal 1d6 necrotic damage (2d6 if Symbiotic Entity is active) when a creature enters or starts its turn within 10 feet. DC 14 Constitution save to negate.

reactions.name: Fungal Infestation
reactions.desc: Animate a Small or Medium beast or humanoid that dies within 10 feet as a zombie for 1 hour.

equipment.notes: Gnarled wood with fungal growths, bioluminescent mushrooms that glow blue-green in darkness

name: Jaylen Shadowstep

special_abilities.name: Sneak Attack
special_abilities.desc: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 3d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll.

special_abilities.name: Cunning Action
special_abilities.desc: You can take a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

special_abilities.name: Uncanny Dodge
special_abilities.desc: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

special_abilities.name: Ear for Deceit
special_abilities.desc: Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to sense if a creature is lying, treat a roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

special_abilities.name: Eye for Detail
special_abilities.desc: You can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object, or to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.

special_abilities.name: Insightful Fighting
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, make a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by a target's Charisma (Deception). If you succeed, you can use Sneak Attack against that target even without advantage for 1 minute.

special_abilities.name: Steady Aim
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, you give yourself advantage on your next attack roll. You can't move on the turn you use this feature.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, plus 10 (3d6) piercing damage if Sneak Attack applies.

bonus_actions.name: Eye for Detail
bonus_actions.desc: Make a Perception or Investigation check.

bonus_actions.desc: Contest Insight vs. Deception to gain ability to Sneak Attack without advantage.

bonus_actions.name: Steady Aim
bonus_actions.desc: Gain advantage on next attack (can't move this turn).
